_comment: POC 5 input pack for the open-state static twin. See docs/pocs/poc5-digital-twin-runbook.md Stage 1. Product: Graco Ready2Jet Kingston. One state per job: all input views show the OPEN stroller; the folded-state image feeds a separate future job.
pack_status: v1.1 ACTIVE 2026-08-27 for the Tripo3D comparative run. The four v1 INPUT views are byte-identical to the Meshy pilot inputs (tool results stay directly comparable). Change from v1: a valid GLOBAL held-out image replaces the close-up held-out, fixing the unsatisfiable silhouette-IoU defect. Remaining v1 defects are carried as accepted, documented risks: canopy-state conflict between view-01 and view-02, no rear view (rear surfaces are inferred by construction; invented-geometry check applies), view-02 SKU confirmation pending. Full v2 (state-consistent, rear coverage) still requires new capture per digital-twin plan Decision 2; v2 requirements remain listed in evaluation/scorecard-meshy-v1-pilot-run-01.md.

product.colorway_note: Corrected 2026-08-14: the collected images are the Kingston gray/tan colorway, i.e. model 2209064 — NOT Splatter Art 2212125 (the model used by the earlier Higgsfield/Seedance POCs). The experiment follows the images. Published dimensions match across both SKUs, but exact-SKU provenance still matters; do not mix assets across the two.
